description.en: Stylized genus-level trace-morphology concept. Zhang et al2015 Figure1a is explicitly a computer reconstruction, distinct from actual Devonian specimen photos e-h. Both were inspected. Broad simple helical sheet, lamellae, marginal tube and cylindrical axial connection supported; exact count,1.25turns, exposures and dimensions artistic. PRI specimen locality/age unknown, inventory eras remain empty. No claim that modeled geometry is a cast of an intact excavated specimen, no assignment of producer or unique behavior.
